failure_criteria: No implementable STRAND summary is available from existing diagrams.
The null operation is invariant to the STRAND input.
Result provenance is insufficient to reconstruct source diagrams, subset size, statistic, and seed.
success_criteria: STRAND finite-lifetime summaries can be computed for H0 and H1 on the toy subset.
A survival-effect statistic and Monte Carlo/permutation null are explicitly defined.
The null operation changes the STRAND input summaries for at least one non-identity null draw.
The toy result can be compared in direction against existing W2 and landscape L2 outputs.

metric_space: Existing P01-B Vietoris-Rips persistence diagrams represented by finite feature lifetimes and empirical persistence-survival functions.
next_on_failure: write [NEGATIVE] note and update Discovery backlog

null_model.invariance_risk: The null must perturb the diagram lifetimes consumed by STRAND, not merely reorder features within a fixed diagram.
null_model.operation: Compare observed persistence-lifetime survival summaries to cached permutation-null diagrams; toy p-values permute observed-vs-null labels across diagram-level STRAND statistics.

outcome_to_prose.failure: Write a NEGATIVE note and keep current W2/landscape testing.
outcome_to_prose.partial: Record the implementation or design gap and park until method details or artifacts improve.
outcome_to_prose.success: Open a pre-reg-to-dispatch handoff for a bounded APM task comparing STRAND against current baselines.

research_question: Can STRAND persistence-survival summaries be computed on existing P01-B persistence diagrams and produce a calibrated toy contrast against current W2 and landscape L2 baselines?

topology_gate.feature_claim_map: STRAND survival curves summarise persistence-feature lifetimes and can localise whether observed diagrams have heavier persistence tails than permutation-null diagrams.
topology_gate.named_baseline: Existing P01-B Wasserstein-2 and persistence-landscape L2 permutation tests.

toy_scope.compute_budget: Bounded toy compute using at most 100 cached null diagrams per dataset and existing diagram files only.
toy_scope.dataset: existing P01-B USoc and BHPS observed diagrams plus cached permutation-null diagrams
